title: Lucid Clarity
description: A lightweight, crisp Vanilla+ shader focused on clean lighting and performance.
body:
# Lucid Clarity — Crisp Vanilla+ Lighting
## What is Lucid Clarity?
Lucid Clarity is a lightweight, high-performance shader pack designed for players who love the classic Minecraft aesthetic but want to improve the atmosphere without the "milky," hazy washout common in many modern shaders.

Instead of relying on heavy performance-heavy features like path tracing or complex shadow maps, Lucid Clarity focuses on refined light falloff, natural color temperatures, and enhanced contrast. The result is a sharp, vibrant, and crystal-clear visual experience that stays true to the game's original style.

## Why choose Lucid Clarity?
Zero Milky Haze: We have optimized the tonemapping and ambient settings to eliminate the grey, washed-out filter found in many other packs.

Vanilla+ Aesthetic: It enhances your world with natural lighting, warmer days, and crisp, cool nights while keeping the game looking like Minecraft.

Total Control: Every visual element is fully customizable directly from the in-game Iris or OptiFine shader settings menu. Adjust Contrast, Saturation, Exposure, and Fog Density on the fly—no need to restart your game.

Performance-First: Designed from the ground up for low-to-mid-range hardware. By skipping complex volumetric fog and heavy reflections, Lucid Clarity ensures your frame rates stay high, even on integrated graphics.

## Feature Highlights
Customizable Sliders: Fine-tune your visual experience with built-in sliders for Contrast, Saturation, Fog, and Exposure.

Optimized Pipeline: Streamlined rendering to ensure maximum compatibility and high FPS.

Easy Integration: Works seamlessly with the latest versions of Minecraft via Iris or OptiFine.

## Compatibility & Requirements
Minecraft Versions: Fully compatible with Minecraft 1.16.5 through 1.21+.

Mod Loaders: Requires the Iris mod (recommended) or OptiFine.

Hardware: Designed for maximum compatibility, making it perfect for laptops and PCs with lower specifications.

# Honest Disclaimer:
Lucid Clarity does not include high-end features like screen-space reflections, complex shadows, or ray-traced water. It is a dedicated performance-focused project built to provide a clean, sharp visual upgrade that doesn't sacrifice your FPS.
